_about: Machine-readable form of the Career OS directive V2.0. It ADDS to each project's existing profile, data and rules; it does not replace them. Where an older project rule disagrees, the note next to the setting says which one wins. Human-readable rules: CAREER_OS_DIRECTIVE.md.

source_of_truth.rule: The newest resume is the only source of professional facts. Never fabricate or inflate.
source_of_truth.known_difference: The 31 Oct resume lists Kubernetes under DevOps; the 23 Oct _master and the _flagship_fullstack .tex do not. Until _master is refreshed, tailored resumes built from the flagship must not add Kubernetes.

candidate.name: Manik Goyal
candidate.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
candidate.experience_wording: 2+ years (state the real figure, 2.2 years, when a form asks for a number)
candidate.current_role: Software Engineer, I2V Systems Pvt. Ltd., Gurugram
candidate.education: B.Tech Information Technology, USICT, GGSIP University, Delhi (Dec 2021 - Jun 2025), CGPA 8.55/10
candidate.objective: A significantly better software engineering role and compensation, in India or abroad, with relocation to Germany (or another suitable country) as the long-term goal.

skills._rule: Only 'verified' skills may be claimed in a resume, email or form answer. Each one appears in the latest resume.
skills._unverified_note: The directive lists React and Python 'subject to validation against my latest resume'. The resume names neither (it says 'Reactive JS', not React). Treat them as skill gaps to learn, never as claims, until the resume is updated.

search._experience_note: Updated requirement (V2.0). Replaces the earlier 0-2 band wherever one is still configured.
search._sponsorship_rule: An office in Germany is not evidence of sponsorship. Record sponsorship only when the posting or the employer's own page says so.

classification._rule: Classify from the stated requirement in the description, never from the title. C is always shown, in its own group, never silently dropped.

A.label: DIRECT MATCH
A.meaning: Stated experience is explicitly compatible with 2.2 years.

B.label: STRONG POTENTIAL MATCH
B.meaning: Range is compatible or flexible, or no experience is stated.

C.label: STRETCH OPPORTUNITY
C.meaning: Senior title or a slightly higher requirement, responsibilities look achievable. Flag it clearly.

D.label: EXPERIENCE MISMATCH
D.meaning: Clearly requires substantially more experience or expertise.

_freshness_rule: Never invent a posting date. A job with no evidence of its date is 'Unknown date', not fresh.
_state_rule: Clicking Apply is not SUBMITTED. SUBMISSION_VERIFIED needs page evidence (confirmation text, reference id or confirmation URL).
_variant_rule: Variants only reorder, reword and trim facts already in the master resume. The original is preserved and every job gets its own copy.

platforms._rule: One entry per platform. 'verified_on' is the date the platform's current terms were last read; null means not yet checked, so check before turning automation on. Never bypass CAPTCHA, rate limits or account restrictions anywhere.

allowed: generate recruiter and hiring-post search queries
analyse job text the user supplies
draft connection notes, outreach and follow-ups
open pages for the user to act on
forbidden: Playwright or extension automation on linkedin.com
scraping profiles or search results with the user's account
auto connect / message / InMail / like / comment / follow / share
linkedin.note: A delay between automated actions does not make them permitted.

greenhouse.note: Public Job Board API for discovery. Human confirms final submission when declarations, eligibility, salary or legal answers are involved.

lever.note: Public Postings API for discovery. Same confirmation rule.

company_career_sites.note: Preferred source for verifying that a listing is real and still open.

limits._rule: No arbitrary caps on discovery, analysis, local records or application preparation. Caps that exist to respect a platform, a mailbox or a paid API stay. Never apply to the same vacancy twice, never send duplicates, never misstate qualifications.

rules: never call a model when code can decide
one large model loaded at a time

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce MX550 2 GB VRAM + Intel Iris Xe

_recruiter_rule: Only publicly posted professional details. No mass messaging: each message is written for one actual job.
safety: never delete configurations, models, databases, browser profiles or scheduled tasks without explicit permission
measure improvements rather than claiming them
